header.headline: MSc Business Analytics graduate in Manchester · came through the upGrad Study Abroad pathway

people.summary: Signed up on Internshala as a 1st-year BBA student, completed a Business Analytics training and did an internship found there. In her final year an Internshala banner introduced her to the SA pathway. After a webinar, a counselling call and a face-to-face session with her parents she enrolled, did year 1 online (82%), applied for year 2, got an unconditional offer and her visa, and reached Manchester in September 2025.

Identity & contact.conflict: Same email on the Study Abroad lead. Sources agree.
